 <section class="elementor-section elementor-top-section elementor-element elementor-element-90aa940 elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default" data-id="90aa940" data-element_type="section" data-e-type="section" data-settings="{&quot;jet_parallax_layout_list&quot;:[],&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;}">
 <div class="elementor-container elementor-column-gap-default">
 <div class="elementor-column elementor-col-100 elementor-top-column elementor-element elementor-element-981a3b2" data-id="981a3b2" data-element_type="column" data-e-type="column">
 <div class="elementor-widget-wrap elementor-element-populated">
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-ae42258 elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="ae42258" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
 <h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Your Exclusive Getaway</h2> </div>
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-0111428 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="0111428" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
 Each of our 14 rooms are designed to immerse our guests in comfort and create a sanctuary in which to unwind after a day&#8217;s adventure. The fully-equipped rooms are designed and styled with decor from all over the world to make you travel through time. </div>

 <h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Superior Deluxe Room</h2> </div>
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-ccfe7cf elementor-widget-divider--view-line elementor-widget elementor-widget-divider" data-id="ccfe7cf" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="divider.default">

 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-609c1db elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="609c1db" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
 <p><span style="font-weight: 400">Our Superior Deluxe Rooms host spacious areas for relaxing, entertaining with unique views over the Atlantic Ocean. Situated on the top floor of the hotel, with 55 sqm, </span><span style="font-weight: 400">you will find comfort and well-being in our king size bed, 100% cotton &amp; 600 thread count sheets, air conditioning, walk-in closet, large balcony and 100% sustainable &amp; vegan toiletries.</span></p>
